- memory_id "1000150": INC-2025-004 was an incident affecting the notifier on 2025-02-06.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000147" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the auth gateway deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.  (about: auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000135": The scheduler is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, scheduler)

- memory_id "1000114": The notifier depends on the event bus for delivery events.  (about: event bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000098": Farah takes the first on-call rotation for Team Dune.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000094": Oskar is on call for the Ember team to start the year.  (about: Oskar, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000082": Lena takes the first Boreal on-call shift of the year.  (about: Team Boreal, Lena)
- memory_id "1000075": Oskar is the only engineer on the Ember team for now.  (about: Oskar, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000068": The webhooks service lives with Team Boreal.  (about: Team Boreal, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000064": The notifier lives with Team Boreal.  (about: Team Boreal, notifier)
- memory_id "1000058": The event bus is owned by Team Boreal.  (about: Team Boreal, event bus)
- memory_id "1000011": As of January 2025, the Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus.  (about: Team Boreal, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000001": In 2025, Team Atlas consists of Priya and Tomasz Nowak.  (about: Team Atlas, Priya, Tomasz Nowak)
